The National Chairman of the Peoples Democratic Party, Abdulrahman Mohammed, has expressed confidence that the party’s candidates will win all elective positions in the 2027 general elections, following the successful nomination of its candidates across the 36 states. The chairman gave the assurance during a meeting of the National Working Committee with state chairmen in Abuja on Tuesday, stressing that the party would adhere to its constitution and established procedures, including holding caucus and expanded National Executive Committee meetings. Ahead of the 2027 general elections, the PDP faces growing uncertainty over its political future and electoral prospects following years of internal crises and divisions that have weakened the party. The concerns have been heightened by the recent position of the party’s National Leader and Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, Nyesom Wike, to support President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid on the platform of the All Progressives Congress, prompting mixed reactions among Nigerians over the PDP’s chances and the prospects of its candidates in the forthcoming elections. The PDP national chairman said the party’s leadership was determined to do everything within its capacity to secure a successful outing in the 2027 elections and contribute to the country’s progress. Mohammed stated, ” I want to use this opportunity to appreciate state chairmen across the federation for the successful nomination of our candidates for the State Houses of Assembly, House of Representatives, Senate and governorship elections across the 36 states. “I commend you for ensuring a smooth nomination process across the federation, which has enabled us to produce our candidates. Our prayer is that, by the grace of Allah, our candidates will emerge victorious in all the positions they are contesting in 2027. Under my leadership, alongside the National Secretary and other members of the National Working Committee, we are committed to doing everything possible to ensure that the outcome of the 2027 elections marks the beginning of a new chapter of success for our great party and, most importantly, our dear nation. “I also appreciate my colleagues in the National Working Committee for their support, advice and contributions to the leadership of the party, as well as their commitment to their respective responsibilities across the states.” The Chairman of the PDP State Chairmen Forum and Imo State Chairman, Austin Nwachukwu, assured the party’s National Working Committee of his colleagues’ readiness to collaborate with the leadership to secure victory in the forthcoming elections. He stated, “I also want to use this opportunity to state that all the states under the leadership of the chairmen are committed to ensuring that the PDP emerges victorious in the forthcoming general elections in Nigeria. “I want to pledge, on behalf of my colleagues, that we are ready to partner with the National Working Committee in every aspect of its activities where our contributions are required. As the party’s foot soldiers in the states, we are prepared to do everything necessary to support the leadership and carry out any assignments given to us. The chairmen are fully prepared to do so.” Nwachukwu alleged that some state governments, particularly those controlled by the APC, were subjecting PDP members, supporters and candidates to intimidation, harassment and attacks. Citing Ebonyi State as an example, he claimed that some PDP members had been attacked and arrested in the South-East state.
